children: CleanSpark completed a $2.276 billion private offering of 7.875% Senior Secured Notes, priced at 98.500% of par, to finance its Sandersville, Georgia data center project, reimburse prior equity contributions, and fund debt service reserves. The company’s subsidiary, CSDC Finance I, entered into an Indenture with U.S. Bank Trust Company as trustee and collateral agent, setting interest, amortization, redemption, and covenant terms through 2031. The sale was executed under a purchase agreement with Morgan Stanley as representative of the initial purchasers under Rule 144A/Reg S. CleanSpark also provided a completion guarantee to ensure the project is finished on time if proceeds and available funds are insufficient.
